test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who, in August 2022, was appointed as the Secretary to the President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IAS Rajesh Verma.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **IAS Rajesh Verma** was appointed as the **Secretary **to the **President of India** in **August 2022.**
 
• Rajesh Verma is a** 1990-batch IAS officer** of the** Uttar Pradesh cadre **and has previously served in various senior positions in the state government as well as in the central government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **IFS Vivek Kumar i**s a **1989-batch Indian Foreign Service officer** who currently serves as** India's Ambassador to Bahrain.**
 
• **Dr. Hiren Joshi **is a **physician** who is currently serving as the** Private Secretary to Prime Minister Narendra Modi.**
 
• **IFS Sanjeev Kumar Singla** is a 1997-batch Indian Foreign Service officer who currently serves as** India's Ambassador to Israel.**
